nodes.text: Erectile dysfunction or decreased libido: assess medical, psychological, and drug history
Check morning testosterone, TSH, and lipid/glucose panel

algorithm.title: Wernicke encephalopathy and Korsakoff amnestic syndrome

nodes.text: Patient with chronic alcohol use disorder presenting with cognitive impairment: evaluate urgency
Immediately administer high-dose parenteral thiamine prior to any glucose infusion
**Acute triad of confusion, ataxia, and ophthalmoplegia:** Wernicke encephalopathy
**Dense anterograde and retrograde amnesia with confabulation:** Korsakoff psychosis
Pathophysiology: thiamine deficiency causing necrosis of mammillary bodies and medial thalamus
Provide structured supportive living environment and continued thiamine supplementation
Engage in comprehensive alcohol rehabilitation and mutual-support programs

nodes.text: Patient requesting advance directive: assess decision-specific decision-making capacity
Engage in direct discussion of patient's values, preferences, and goals of care
**Patient demonstrates understanding of choices, appreciation of consequences, and consistent reasoning:** execute advance directive
**Patient lacks capacity due to severe delirium, dementia, or psychosis:** seek surrogate decision-maker
Recognize that capacity does not require normal formal cognitive scores or higher education
Document capacity determination and specific treatment preferences in the medical record
